episode: East Bench House Phase 3, Master Suite and Laundry Room
video_title_note: PLACEHOLDER. Replace with the long video's exact YouTube title before publishing, then rebuild; the VO resynthesizes on its own.
assessment: Phase three of the East Bench House: the master suite and the laundry room. A strong showcase episode, weak for problem and solution beyond one beat: the homeowners never used the old tub because it was uncomfortable, and the old shower head sat in an odd spot. The finished master bath carries the Short. Mike calls the shower a car wash, with nozzles, hand sprays, shower heads and an LED rain head that changes colour from a remote, plus a wrap around lit niche. Then a deep jetted tub with air bubbles and a hand spray, sinks made from the countertop material, outlets and USB ports in the back of the drawers, and a fountain wall that is a mirror when the water is off. The laundry took over the old walk in closet and has a built in ironing board. Mike is in most of the reveal, so every shot is cropped to the feature with him at the edge or out.
